3. Fixed error of Tenshi "Quatz" Spell being usable in the main menu.

notes.title: Update 05! QOL changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Adventure Realm has now been updated yet again with a few QOL improvements and minor changes to certain parts of the game.

[b][u]QOL Change.[/u][/b]

"Bronze Halo", "Silver Halo", "Gold Halo" and "Gem Life" will now add the state "Life Shield" to the targeted member.
This state reduces all damage to 10% of it's original damage. This is to help players survive better after being revived and not get instantly K.O'ed again. The effect will be removed after a short time or taking damage. 

A "Press Space to start" prompt has been added to the title screen.

[b][u]Minor Boss change[/u][/b]

Ventus Claw action will now deal damage and knock the target to the 4th row.

Ignis background for his boss encounter has now changed. 

[b][u]Bug fixes.[/u][/b]

Fixed a Bug where defeating the "Tri Terror Dragon" prevented the player from passing.
Minor change to the Final Dungeon Area 1 to make jumping easier.

notes.title: Update 4! Controller and WASD!
notes.notes:
The latest update to Adventure Realm has now provided controller support and fixed an Error where WASD would not work correctly.

[b][u]Old save files no longer compatible. [/u][/b]
Sadly due to this update and some internal changes that was required to add controller support old save files will no longer work with the current version.

To fix this error so player do not lose progress. A "New Game Data" feature has been added to the game.

This allows players to start a new game and edit the game data so they can replicate their old save file as closely as possible.

This does provide players to skip sections of the game they have not reached but this was the only way to ensure players do not lose any progress made in the game.

[b][u]It is recommended for players to delete all their old saved data [/u][/b] to ensure no errors will occur. 

[u][b]Accessing the Set  "New Game Data"
[/b][/u]
Players only need to start a New Game and select Set "New Game Data" and this will take them through various options to edit the game and allow them to set their desired point in the game.

The Game will act as IF the dungeons has been cleared story wise, but dungeon coins, enemies, Elites and Treasure Spheres will still be active.

I apologies for this error. 

Summary.
1. Controller support now added.
2. WASD Key's error now fixed.
3. New Game State feature has been added.
